title: Hereditary Diameter Rigidity in Real $L_1$-Spaces
summary: We prove that hereditary diameter lower bounds are stable under convex combinations in real $L_1$-spaces over arbitrary measure spaces. More precisely, if every weakly open piece of each set has diameter at least $δ>0$, then every finite or countable convex combination has the corresponding hereditary lower bound $δ/4$. In the diameter-two case, the bound is preserved exactly.
